# Linnea Marqmoor

Linnea Marqmoor is currently a Yield Forecast Analyst at Nexvane Networks, where she specializes in applying machine learning techniques to predict harvest volumes within vertical farming systems. Since joining Nexvane in 2021, Linnea has focused on advancing PhytaTrack, the company’s flagship platform that integrates real-time environmental sensor data with AI algorithms to optimize nutrient dosing schedules and improve crop yield consistency.

Before Nexvane, Linnea worked from 2017 to 2020 at Agrolytix Solutions, where she led the "Project VerdantEye," a data-driven yield prediction initiative that increased forecasting accuracy by 18% through novel ensemble models and sensor fusion methods. Her expertise centers on time-series analysis, sensor data integration, and deploying scalable machine learning pipelines specifically tailored for controlled-environment agriculture.

Linnea approaches her work with a collaborative and iterative style, valuing continuous feedback loops between data scientists, agronomists, and hardware engineers. She frequently partners with Nexvane’s crop nutrition team and sensor hardware division to refine PhytaTrack’s algorithms in field-like grow towers located at the company’s Redwood facility. Known for her attention to detail and pragmatic problem-solving, Linnea thrives in cross-disciplinary teams focused on advancing the precision and reliability of indoor farming operations.
